setMyDescription.description:
Degen Desk posts crypto trading signals and market notes.

• BTC (and occasional gold) trade signals with chart, entry, stop and target
• Hourly memecoin "trenches picks" with conviction scores (only tokens called by 2+ accounts)
• BTC, ETH and SOL prices

The bot only posts to its groups and doesn't take trades for you. Not financial advice. Always do your own research.
